_comment: FleetManagement/.releaserc.json — semantic-release config. Branches off main only; npm publish disabled (private monorepo root). Protected main: @semantic-release/git is intentionally OMITTED — the default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot bypass branch protection (GitHub by design), and the deploy reads from the local worktree, not a committed CHANGELOG/version, so the GitHub Release + tag (via @semantic-release/github) are the changelog of record. No commit-back to main, no PAT/bypass actor. Plugin order is load-bearing: analyzer -> notes -> changelog -> github.
